cases.name: shared_event_classifier
cases.expected: project and EventHandler::handles use the same pure classifier for Comments lifecycle events

cases.name: blog_post_target_filter
cases.expected: only Comments lifecycle events whose target_type is blog_post are projected

cases.name: created_deleted_delta
cases.expected: comment.created increments by one and comment.deleted decrements by one

cases.name: envelope_idempotency
cases.expected: the event envelope id is the delivery-ledger primary key and an existing delivery is acknowledged without another counter update

cases.name: atomic_counter_delivery_outbox
cases.expected: the optimistic counter update, delivery insert, and BlogPostUpdated outbox publication share one database transaction

cases.name: tenant_scoped_optimistic_update
cases.expected: the post lookup and update require tenant identity and the observed post version, with a bounded retry loop

cases.name: missing_post_retry
cases.expected: a missing tenant post returns an error before the delivery marker is committed so the event runtime can retry

cases.name: non_negative_count
cases.expected: the pure counter transition floors deletes at zero and saturates count and version overflow

cases.name: postgres_duplicate_delivery
cases.expected: the retained PostgreSQL target replays one envelope id and expects one counter transition, one delivery row, and one outbox row

cases.name: postgres_out_of_order_delete_create
cases.expected: the retained PostgreSQL target delivers delete before create and expects a non-negative count with monotonic versions

cases.name: postgres_missing_post_recovery
cases.expected: the retained PostgreSQL target expects no delivery or outbox commit while the post is missing, then replays the same envelope after source creation

cases.name: postgres_outbox_rollback_recovery
cases.expected: the retained PostgreSQL target removes the outbox table, expects counter and delivery rollback, recreates the table, and replays the same envelope

cases.name: module_listener_registration
cases.expected: Blog registers BlogCommentProjectionHandler through the module event-listener registry

runtime_promotion_requirements: execute the env-gated PostgreSQL comment_projection_postgres_test target and retain its output
retain proof that duplicate and out-of-order comment.created/comment.deleted deliveries match the source harness assertions
retain proof that the counter, delivery ledger, and BlogPostUpdated outbox row commit or roll back together
retain missing-post retry and later recovery evidence
retain concurrent optimistic-update exhaustion and retry evidence
retain host event-dispatch registration and restart recovery evidence
